character.teleport.summary: Move the actor's character to the specified position with PivotTo.

character.moveTo.source: Humanoid:MoveTo and wait for MoveToFinished; fails if not reached within the step timeout. Client alternative: input.move.
character.moveTo.summary: Move the character with Humanoid:MoveTo. Wait for MoveToFinished. The step fails if the character does not get to the target before timeout. For client input, use input.move.

character.loaded.source: Actor has a character with a Humanoid and HumanoidRootPart, parented to Workspace.
character.loaded.summary: True if the actor's character is in Workspace and contains a Humanoid and HumanoidRootPart.

character.alive.source: Character loaded, Humanoid.Health > 0 and not in the Dead state.
character.alive.summary: True if the character is loaded, has health above zero, and is not in the Dead state.

character.dead.source: No character, Humanoid.Health <= 0, or the Humanoid is in the Dead state.
character.dead.summary: True if there is no character, its health is zero or less, or its Humanoid is in the Dead state.

character.near.source: HumanoidRootPart within radius studs of to.
character.near.summary: True if the distance from the HumanoidRootPart to the target position is less than or equal to the radius.

character.hasTool.source: Actor has the tool (Backpack or character); with equipped: true, it must be in the character.
character.hasTool.summary: True if the actor has the tool in the Backpack or character. With equipped: true, the tool must be in the character.

tool.source: Tool name (searched in Backpack, then character) or selector
tool.description: A Tool name or selector. Stagehand searches the Backpack, then the character.

input.click.source: Mouse click at a GuiObject's centre (waits for it to appear and be visible, within the step timeout) / BasePart's screen position, or at a screen position. Moves the cursor along a short curve first (visualised in the client window).
input.click.summary: Click the center of a GuiObject, a BasePart's screen position, or a specified screen position. For a GuiObject, wait until it is in view, up to the step timeout. The client window shows the cursor movement along a short curve.

input.mouseMove.source: Move the mouse to a screen position (moves the cursor along a short curve, visualised in the client window) or by a raw delta.
input.mouseMove.summary: Move the mouse to a specified screen position or by a raw delta. For movement to a position, the client window shows a short curve.

gui.click.source: Wait for a GuiButton to appear and be visible (within the step timeout), then activate it with a VirtualInput click at its centre (the cursor glides there along a short curve, visualised in the client window).
gui.click.summary: Wait for a GuiButton to come into view, up to the step timeout. Then click its center with VirtualInput. The client window shows the cursor movement along a short curve.

gui.setText.source: Wait for a TextBox to appear and be visible, set its Text and fire FocusLost(enterPressed=true).
gui.setText.summary: Wait for a TextBox to come into view. Set its Text property. Then send FocusLost with enterPressed=true.

gui.visible.source: GuiObject and all ancestors Visible/Enabled, and on screen.
gui.visible.summary: True if the GuiObject is on screen and it and its ancestors have the applicable Visible or Enabled property set.

gui.text.summary: Compare the Text property of a TextLabel, TextBox, or TextButton.

remote.fire.summary: Call RemoteEvent:FireServer(args...) from the actor's client.

name.source: Remote name (searched recursively in ReplicatedStorage) or selector
name.description: A remote name or selector. Stagehand searches all descendants of ReplicatedStorage.

remote.invoke.source: RemoteFunction:InvokeServer(args...) from the actor's client; returns the first result.
remote.invoke.summary: Call RemoteFunction:InvokeServer(args...) from the actor's client. Return the first result.

name.source: Remote name (searched recursively in ReplicatedStorage) or selector
name.description: A remote name or selector. Stagehand searches all descendants of ReplicatedStorage.

name.source: Remote name (searched recursively in ReplicatedStorage) or selector
name.description: A remote name or selector. Stagehand searches all descendants of ReplicatedStorage.

instance.clone.source: Clone target into parent; returns the clone's path.
instance.clone.summary: Copy the target into the specified parent. Return the new instance's path.

name.description: The name for the new instance.

instance.call.source: Call a method: target:method(args...); returns the first result.
instance.call.summary: Call target:method(args...). Return the first result.

instance.childCount.summary: Compare the number of children returned by GetChildren().

log.matches.source: Some captured Output line matches a Lua pattern.
log.matches.summary: True if a recorded Output line matches the specified Lua pattern.

scope.source: all = every node in the session (evaluated by the daemon over log events since run start); node = the resolved node only
scope.description: all: the daemon uses log events from every session node after the start of the run. node: only the selected node.

log.noErrors.source: No error-level Output captured since run start.
log.noErrors.summary: True if Stagehand recorded no error-level Output after the start of the run.

scope.source: all = every node in the session (evaluated by the daemon over log events since run start); node = the resolved node only
scope.description: all: the daemon uses log events from every session node after the start of the run. node: only the selected node.

session.addPlayers.source: Add simulated players to a multiplayer session (StudioTestService:AddPlayers). New clients get the next playerIndex.
session.addPlayers.summary: Add simulated players to a multiplayer session with StudioTestService:AddPlayers. New clients get the next playerIndex.

count.description: An integer from 1 to 7. The total player count must be 8 or less.

player.setTeam.source: Set the actor's Team by Teams child name.
player.setTeam.summary: Set the actor's Team. Use the name of a child in Teams.

player.respawn.source: Respawn the actor (Player:LoadCharacter) and wait for the new character.
player.respawn.summary: Call Player:LoadCharacter for the actor. Wait for the new character.

player.giveTool.source: Clone a Tool into the actor's Backpack.
player.giveTool.summary: Copy a Tool into the actor's Backpack.

tool.source: Tool name searched in ServerStorage, ReplicatedStorage, StarterPack (first match), or a selector
tool.description: A Tool name or selector. Stagehand searches ServerStorage, ReplicatedStorage, and StarterPack in that order. It uses the first match.

player.onTeam.summary: True if the actor's Team name equals the team parameter.

character.equipTool.source: Equip a Tool from the actor's Backpack (Humanoid:EquipTool).
character.equipTool.summary: Equip a Tool from the actor's Backpack (Humanoid:EquipTool).

tool.source: Tool name (searched in Backpack, then character) or selector
tool.description: A Tool name or selector. Stagehand searches the Backpack, then the character.

input.key.source: Press a key via VirtualInput (down, hold, up).
input.key.summary: Press a key through VirtualInput. Hold the key for the specified duration. Then release it.

instance.destroy.summary: Remove the selected instances with Destroy.

instance.exists.source: Selector matches at least one instance.
instance.exists.summary: True if the selector matches one or more instances.

instance.hasTag.summary: True if the selected instances have the CollectionService tag.
